title: Build cluster models and optimize geometries at LDA level
action: Construct the Si9H12, Si9H13, and Si9H14 cluster models as finite representations of the Si(100) surface dimer with hydrogen termination of subsurface atoms. Apply constraints: freeze deeper-layer silicon and terminating H; allow selected second-layer motion; fully relax surface Si and attached H. Optimize geometries at LDA level (Dirac exchange + VWN correlation).
description: LDA-optimized cluster geometries; process evidence, not scored.

title: Compute single-point energies at VWN+BP/TZVPP level
action: Using LDA-optimized geometries from Step 1, perform single-point energy calculations with the VWN+BP nonlocal functional (VWN local spin-density reference + Becke exchange + Perdew correlation, applied perturbatively) and the cc-pVTZ basis set (surrogate for TZVPP). Calculate total energies for Si9H14, Si9H13, Si9H12, H, and H2.
description: Total energies; process evidence, not scored.

title: Calculate and output reaction energies
action: From the total energies in total_energies.json, compute the three reaction energies: E1 (Si9H14→Si9H13+H), E2 (Si9H13→Si9H12+H), E3 (Si9H14→Si9H12+H2) as described in the Approach. Convert to kcal/mol and store in the output file.
description: The three reaction energies in kcal/mol, the central reproduction target.
